meta_description:
145 likes, 469 comments - drsnehal_adsule on September 13, 2026: "If you read that list and thought, “That’s literally me”, this is for you.

I see so many women in their 30s stuck in the same cycle.

They lose 5 kg.
Then life happens and they gain it back.

They start cutting carbs.
Then the cravings become impossible to control.

They skip meals during the day.
Then they are starving and snacking at night.

They start exercising.
Then one busy week throws everything off.

They feel tired all the time.
So they rely on chai or coffee to get through the day.

Then they notice more hair fall, dull skin, bloating and stubborn belly fat.

And slowly, they start thinking:

“Maybe my metabolism is slow.”

“Maybe this is just what happens after 30.”

“Maybe I just need more willpower.”

But please don’t reduce everything to weight.

If your body is feeling different, look at the bigger picture.

How much protein are you actually eating?

Are your meals keeping you full?

Are you eating enough fibre?

Are you going hours without food and then struggling with cravings at night?

Are you sleeping well?

Are you constantly stressed?

Are you moving regularly, or only exercising when you are trying to lose weight?

How is your digestion?

Has your period or cycle changed?

And if you have persistent hair fall or fatigue, have you actually looked into the possible causes instead of just starting another supplement?

You do not need to completely change your life.

You do not need to stop eating roti and rice.

You do not need to survive on salads.

You do not need to start another extreme diet every Monday.

You need to understand what your body needs and build habits you can actually maintain.

Because losing the same 5 kg every year is not the goal.

Feeling energetic, nourished, strong, comfortable in your body and being able to maintain a healthy weight is the goal.

If you are a woman in your 30s and you relate to this, I made my FREE Healthy Woman Blueprint to help you understand the key foundations you should be looking at for your health.

DM me “HEALTHY” and I’ll send it to you for FREE💜".
